caption: The drawing depicts two silver spoons set against a plain, off-white background with a wide, unevenly applied wash of pale yellow-beige framing the central composition. The spoon on the left is shown in a frontal view, displaying the entirety of its bowl and handle. The spoon on the right is depicted in profile, presenting the side edge of both bowl and handle. Both spoons have elongated oval bowls and handles that widen and flatten at the end with a rounded top that features a shallow indentation at the center. The initials "SRCS" are inscribed near the end of each handle. The rendering is highly detailed, with subtle shading and contour lines that suggest the metallic reflectiveness of the objects. The artist's signature, "ARCHIE THOMPSON," appears in small, light lettering at the lower right corner of the inner portion of the drawing.
title: Bishop Hill: Large Silver Spoon
